description: This file contains PHPUnit test cases for the LocalizedDateFormatter class within the OrangeHRM project. It tests various date formatting scenarios with localization, including caching behavior and non-localizable formats.

classes.name: LocalizedDateFormatterTest
classes.description: PHPUnit test class for testing localized date formatting functionality.

methods.name: testFormatDate
methods.description: Tests the formatting of various dates with different formats and localization mappings.

methods.name: dataProviderForFormatDate
methods.description: Provides datasets for testing date formatting with different localization mappings and expected outcomes.

methods.name: testFormatDateWithCachingForSameFormat
methods.description: Verifies that date formatting caching works correctly when formatting the same date multiple times with the same format.

methods.name: testFormatDateWithCachingForDifferentFormat
methods.description: Verifies that caching behaves correctly when formatting the same date with different formats.

methods.name: testFormatDateWithNonLocalizableFormat
methods.description: Ensures that no localization calls are made when the format does not include localizable parts.
